# Zeros Studio

Zeros Studio is a premium web design and development agency crafting high-performance websites, UI/UX designs, and custom digital experiences for startups, growing brands, and enterprises globally.

## Core Information
- **Website URL**: https://zerosstudio.in/ (Mirror: https://zerosstudio.vercel.app/)
- **Headquarters**: Vijaynagar, Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India (Serving clients worldwide across all cities, states, and countries)
- **Primary Services**: Custom Web Development, UI/UX Design, AI Video Generation, SEO & Digital Marketing, Brand Identity, website maintenance.
- **Contact Email**: zeros.studio19@gmail.com
- **Phone Contacts**: +91 9334454142 | +91 8009777605

- [Home](https://zerosstudio.in/index.html): Introduction to Zeros Studio, core service highlights, featured projects, customer stats, pricing summary, and FAQs.
- [About Us](https://zerosstudio.in/about.html): Our agency's story, vision, timeline of milestones, and client-centric process.
- [Services](https://zerosstudio.in/services.html): In-depth breakdown of web development, UI/UX design, AI videos, SEO, and branding offerings, along with service FAQs.
- [Portfolio & Projects](https://zerosstudio.in/projects.html): Grid of custom websites we have built (Event Planner, Beauty Parlour, Coffee Shop, Dental Clinic, Gift Shop, Real Estate).
- [Pricing Plans](https://zerosstudio.in/Purchase.html): Detailed tiers (Starter, Business, Enterprise) with transparent features, add-on pricing, and currency toggles (INR/USD).
- [Contact Page](https://zerosstudio.in/Contact.html): Dynamic client intake questionnaire to specify web design goals, style preferences, required features, budget, and timeline.
